entities.summary: The University of Agricultural Sciences and Veterinary Medicine of Cluj-Napoca (USAMVCN) is a university in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. With around 6,000 students, the university offers 21 undergraduate programs; all are available in Romanian, 2 in French and 1 in English. Additionally, the university offers 23 Master programs.
